content.recovery.entry.heading: Recover your account
content.recovery.entry.description: Start a request to regain access to your Tunner account.
content.recovery.entry.goal: What do you need help with?
content.recovery.entry.neutral: Recovery instructions do not confirm whether an account exists.
content.recovery.entry.optionsUnavailable: Recovery options are not available for this request.
content.recovery.proof.heading: Verify this recovery request
content.recovery.proof.description: Use a method available for this request to continue.
content.recovery.proof.permitted: Only permitted recovery methods appear here.
content.recovery.code.heading: Use a recovery code
content.recovery.code.description: Enter a recovery code for this request.
content.recovery.code.label: Recovery code
content.recovery.expired.heading: Verification expired
content.recovery.expired.description: This verification can no longer be used for this recovery request.
content.recovery.expired.noticeDescription: Review its current status before attempting another verification.
content.recovery.unknown.heading: Check your recovery result
content.recovery.unknown.description: We couldn’t confirm the result of this request.
content.recovery.unknown.noticeDescription: Check the original request before starting another action.
content.recovery.pendingReview.heading: Further review is required
content.recovery.pendingReview.description: Further review is needed before this recovery request can continue.
content.recovery.pendingReview.noticeDescription: No recovery outcome is confirmed yet. Check this request for updates.
content.recovery.pendingReview.boundary: Contacting support cannot replace the required verification.
content.recovery.denied.heading: Recovery cannot continue
content.recovery.denied.description: This recovery request was not approved.
content.recovery.denied.noticeDescription: Check the original request for its current outcome.
content.recovery.cancelled.heading: Recovery request cancelled
content.recovery.cancelled.description: This recovery request has been cancelled.
content.recovery.cancelled.noticeDescription: Cancellation does not reverse any completed recovery action.
content.recovery.result.heading: Recovery result
content.recovery.result.description: Review the outcome and any follow-up steps for this recovery request.
content.recovery.result.unavailableDescription: The details needed to confirm this recovery are not available.
content.recovery.result.none: No effects were reported for this result.
content.recovery.result.noFollowUps: No follow-up steps were reported for this result.
content.recovery.result.boundary: This update does not confirm that sign-in access has been restored.
content.recovery.error.unavailable: The recovery request could not be completed. Check its status before trying again.
